executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors due to constructor and method signature mismatches across DTOs, services, and exception handlers. The primary root cause is that test code expects different constructor signatures and methods than what the production code provides. Fixes require updating either the DTO/service signatures to match test expectations or updating test code to use correct signatures.

errors.message: no suitable constructor found for TaskCreateRequest(String,String)
errors.root_cause: TaskCreateRequest constructor expects 4 parameters (title, description, priority, dueDate) but tests are calling it with only 2 parameters (title, description)
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskCreateRequest constructor calls in tests to include Priority and LocalDateTime parameters, or add a 2-parameter constructor overload to TaskCreateRequest class

errors.root_cause: TaskUpdateRequest constructor expects 5 parameters (title, description, priority, status, dueDate) but tests are calling it with only 3 parameters
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskUpdateRequest constructor calls in tests to include Priority and LocalDateTime parameters, or add a 3-parameter constructor overload to TaskUpdateRequest class

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse constructor expects 9 parameters but tests are calling it with 6 parameters. Missing parameters: createdAt, updatedAt, and userId
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskResponse constructor calls in tests to include all 9 required parameters (id, title, description, priority, status, dueDate, createdAt, updatedAt, userId)

errors.root_cause: TaskService interface does not define getAllTasks() method but tests are calling it
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getAllTasks() method to TaskService interface and implement it in TaskServiceImpl, or update tests to use the correct method name if it exists with a different signature

errors.root_cause: TaskService interface does not define getTasksByStatus(TaskStatus) method but tests are calling it
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getTasksByStatus(TaskStatus) method to TaskService interface and implement it in TaskServiceImpl

errors.message: no suitable constructor found for DatabaseConnectionException(String)
errors.root_cause: DatabaseConnectionException constructor expects 2 or 3 parameters (message, context, [throwable]) but tests are calling it with only 1 parameter (message)
errors.fix_recommendation: Update DatabaseConnectionException constructor calls in tests to include the context parameter, or add a single-parameter constructor overload to DatabaseConnectionException class

errors.message: method handleDatabaseException cannot be applied to given types; required: DatabaseConnectionException,HttpServletRequest
errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler.handleDatabaseException() expects 2 parameters (exception, request) but tests are calling it with only 1 parameter (exception)
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all exception handler method calls in tests to include HttpServletRequest parameter, or modify exception handler methods to make HttpServletRequest optional

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class does not define getErrorCode() method but tests are calling it
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getErrorCode() method to ErrorResponse class or update tests to use the correct field accessor method

errors.message: incompatible types: String cannot be converted to Long
errors.root_cause: TaskNotFoundException constructor expects Long type for task ID but tests are passing String
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskNotFoundException constructor calls in tests to pass Long.valueOf() or change the test to use Long type directly

errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore does not define findByStatus(TaskStatus) method but tests are calling it
errors.fix_recommendation: Add findByStatus(TaskStatus) method to TaskDataStore interface and implement it in InMemoryTaskDataStore class

errors.message: incompatible types: void cannot be converted to boolean
errors.root_cause: Test is trying to assign void return type to boolean variable. The delete method likely returns void instead of boolean
errors.fix_recommendation: Change delete method in TaskDataStore to return boolean indicating success/failure, or update tests to not expect a return value from delete operations

errors.root_cause: ValidationException class does not define getErrors() method but tests are calling it
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getErrors() method to ValidationException class to return the list of validation errors, or update tests to use the correct method to access validation errors

summary: 12 grouped compilation errors found across test files
